The '''Alderaan Peace Summit''' was a peace summit held by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sidonie Garen]] in an attempt to bring an end to the [[Alderaan Civil War]] amongst the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]]. However, Garen was infected by the [[Dark Plague]], and nearly caused permanent conflict between the Houses before she was [[Mission to Alderaan (Barsen'thor)|stopped]] by a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]].<ref name="Crisis Situation" />
